annotations.title: Create paid account (no trial, card required)

description: Create a new organization that goes STRAIGHT TO PAID — no free trial month. A payment method is MANDATORY: pass a `card` object; the card is verified with the clearing provider, its token is saved, and billing starts immediately (first charge on the next billing run). Use this when an AI agent has the customer's card and should provision a paying account in one call. Same number options and the same graceful companyInfo.timezone/country handling as gambot_create_trial_account (neither hard-fails). The raw card is sent only to the PCI-compliant clearing provider and never stored.

card.description: REQUIRED. { cardNumber, expirationDate ("MM/YY" or "MM/YYYY"), cvv?, holderId? }.

companyInfo.description: { organizationName (required), timezone (IANA, recommended; derived from country if omitted), country (ISO-3166 alpha-2), companyName, idNumber, companyUrl, companyPhoneNumber }.

name: gambot_create_paid_account
